skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concept of the securities market, primary and secondary markets, and the roles of market participants.
Understand the concept of securities and the ability to value securities.
Understand the issuance of securities on stock exchanges and over-the-counter markets, and the management and supervision of the market.
Develop group work skills through improved communication in a dynamic environment and the ability to self-study and accumulate experience to enhance knowledge.
Improve communication skills in a dynamic environment and the ability to self-study and accumulate experience to enhance knowledge.
Develop the ability to self-study and accumulate experience to enhance knowledge.
Apply critical thinking to analyze and value securities.
Conduct research on stock exchanges and over-the-counter markets.
Analyze and understand the operations of stock exchanges and over-the-counter markets.
Understand different types of financial instruments such as stocks, bonds, and derivatives.

prerequisite_courses: Lý thuyết tài chính tiền tệ 1
